summary: The bank sounds like DUMMIES: Luxury lines are dry and superior, Corporate lines are forms and logs, and the tier-free lines are calm. Each line is true to its conditions and fits the 48-character limit. One issue is left: a SETTLED fix was not applied to c031, which still has the shout style.

issues.rule: Luxury (tier 01) is polished and faintly amused, so it speaks, it does not shout. Shout style is for the angry Budget tier. An earlier round settled this fix (lines[30].style: shout -> speech), but the content still has shout.
